answer_1.quote: We use four datasets ... each dataset includes human annotations for pairwise comparisons of two outputs of an instruction, with a binary label indicating which output is better ... InstruSum contains human annotations for instruction-controllable summarization ... MTBench contains expert human annotations made by graduate students for multi-turn conversations.
answer_1.outputs: Pairwise comparison judgments indicating which of two model-generated responses better follows the instruction

answer_2.quote: We mainly use evaluation accuracy to evaluate the LLM-evaluators, which measures the alignment with human evaluations using human annotations as the gold standard.

answer_3.quote: LLM-based evaluation methods... a strong LLM is used to evaluate the quality of model responses ... we evaluate the evaluation protocols ... using pairwise comparison of different LLMs' outputs.

answer_4.quote: Each dataset includes human annotations for pairwise comparisons of two outputs of an instruction, with a binary label indicating which output is better ... these human annotations serve as the gold standard for meta‑evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators label which of the two outputs better follows the instruction (binary choice).
